Nakul Dhull reacted to a fight with fellow contestant Gullu, also known as Kushal Tanwar, inside the Bigg Boss 20 house, quoting a remark that begins with “Apne”.

Elvish Yadav commented on the same incident, saying “Jo pitra hai usi ko bahar karre hai” in reference to the physical altercation.

Some reports claim Dhull was evicted just two days after entering the house, while others say he has not been removed and remains a contestant following the clash with Gullu. These differing reports were carried by the Times of India, NDTV, Telegraph India and iDiva.
